identity.one_of_one_hook: Regal vampiric blood magic turned into an ally-protecting shield and repeatable sustain
identity.silhouette_read: Pale long hair, pointed ears, layered blood-red cape, spikes and radiant blood-magic crescent
identity.gameplay_promise: Protect frontline allies and convert combat pressure into protective Ichor
identity.counterplay: Create openings when barrier/bond are unavailable; numeric tuning untested

design.visual_identity: Lavender-white hair, red eyes, gothic black-purple plate, crimson enamel, antique gold, luminous magenta ichor
design.signature_prop: Ornate gold-and-crimson magical bloodshield; shield is Vellaris's unique identity, not a tank default
design.accessibility_notes: Check contrast, gameplay-distance silhouette, VFX obstruction, color-blind readability, sound alternatives and safe flashes in real tests.
